summary.zh: 分析物料覆盖、供需项目和 MRP 异常消息，解释缺料与重排原因并给出处理优先级。
summary.en: Analyzes material coverage, supply-demand items and MRP exception messages to explain shortages, rescheduling needs and priorities.

zh: 工厂或 MRP 控制员
物料或物料组
短缺参数文件与计数器
评估期间
en: Plant or MRP controller
Material or material group
Shortage profile and counter
Evaluation horizon

zh: 短缺物料清单
供需缺口与异常消息
重排和催办建议
优先级及证据
en: Shortage material list
Supply-demand gaps and exception messages
Rescheduling and expediting recommendations
Priority and evidence

zh: 必须显式提供短缺参数文件和计数器
空结果与超时不得解释为无短缺
只建议处理动作，不运行 MRP 或修改凭证
分页或关键字段不完整时返回 INCONCLUSIVE
en: Require an explicit shortage profile and counter
Never interpret empty or timed-out results as no shortage
Recommend actions only; do not run MRP or change documents
Return INCONCLUSIVE for incomplete pages or key fields

description.zh: 确定物料、工厂、MRP 范围、控制员和短缺定义。
description.en: Resolve material, plant, MRP area, controller and shortage definition.

zh: 要求至少提供物料、工厂或控制员之一。
默认标准短缺参数文件也必须显式记录。
en: Require at least a material, plant or controller.
Record even the standard shortage profile explicitly.

purpose.zh: 防止无界 MRP 查询。

description.zh: 确认只读连接并验证 MRP 三类实体。
description.en: Confirm read-only connectivity and the three MRP entity contracts.

zh: 检查 Thin Runtime 健康和只读状态。
验证 A_MRPMaterial、SupplyDemandItems 和 MaterialCoverages 字段。
en: Check Thin Runtime health and read-only state.
Validate fields for A_MRPMaterial, SupplyDemandItems and MaterialCoverages.

description.zh: 读取 MRP 类型、控制员、安全库存和计划策略。
description.en: Read MRP type, controller, safety stock and planning strategy.

zh: 按物料、工厂和 MRP 范围精确过滤。
保存主数据键和删除标识。
en: Filter exactly by material, plant and MRP area.
Preserve master-data keys and deletion indicators.

description.zh: 读取短缺数量、覆盖天数、MRP 元素和异常消息。
description.en: Read shortage quantity, days of supply, MRP elements and exception messages.

zh: MaterialCoverages 必须带短缺参数文件和计数器。
SupplyDemandItems 按物料和工厂收窄并读取完整分页。
en: MaterialCoverages must include shortage profile and counter.
Narrow SupplyDemandItems by material and plant and read all pages.

description.zh: 通过 SAPSkillhub 读取 MDKP/MDTB 作为独立证据。
description.en: Use SAPSkillhub to read MDKP/MDTB as independent evidence.

zh: 仅导出低行数验证样本并记录查询时间。
把权限、空表和导出超时与业务无短缺区分。
en: Export only a low-row validation sample and record timing.
Distinguish authorization, empty-table and export timeouts from no shortage.

purpose.zh: 导出 MRP 清单只读证据。

description.zh: 按缺口、日期、异常码和业务影响形成优先级。
description.en: Prioritize by shortage, date, exception code and business impact.

zh: 合并同一物料的短缺、重排和计划订单证据。
输出原因、建议责任方、技术键和可信度。
en: Combine shortage, rescheduling and planned-order evidence per material.
Present cause, suggested owner, technical keys and confidence.

purpose.zh: 将超时或缺页标为 INCONCLUSIVE。
purpose.en: Marks timeouts or missing pages as INCONCLUSIVE.
